plan.title: fix(design-critique): land the decided critic method and rename the overloaded Stop 3 heading

narratives.Description: The Stop 3 section that should tell a critic how to critique contains only parent-facing dispatch rules. There is no critic-facing method anywhere in the contract, while the bind path already consumes a finding-classification taxonomy that no shipped surface obliges any critic to produce. Eight decided obligations land at three distinct strengths, Stop 3's overloaded heading is renamed, and token-level pins replace a weak substring pin that let a hollow section stay green.
narratives.Overview: Bound SoT is round-2 successor lean 5390589646; round-1 lean 5390526061 is superseded. Arc closed at the dual-stop ceiling of two critic posts. The issue body's line numbers were derived at bf3929c1 and #3660 has since merged (269a07e5), so they have shifted again -- re-derive every citation with `git grep -n` before editing. A PowerShell line counter disagreed with git on this file during the #3660 build; trust git.
narratives.Labels: enhancement, design, process, area:skills, status:child, design-critique:triage-ready
narratives.UserStory: As a critic dispatched from the contract alone, I want the contract to state the method I am obliged to follow at its real strength, so that classification, re-verification and evidence anatomy are contract obligations rather than things a particular parent happened to ask for in a hand-written envelope.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Re-derive all line numbers at current origin/master with `git grep -n`; the body's bf3929c1 numbers are stale after #3660. 2. Rename Stop 3's `### Charter` to a name stating what it is (parent-facing dispatch rules). Measured at bf3929c1 the Stop 3 sense had four sites: contract:65, contract:69, brief:39, test:19. Re-derive and update all of them. test:19's weak `"## Charter"` substring pin will go red -- that is the intended forcing function. 3. Add a new, clearly-named critic-method heading and land the eight decided obligations at their decided strengths: five MUST (re-verify anchors by running checks / line cites are claims not evidence; inventory existing mechanisms before proposing new ones; classify every finding with the exact three tokens; finding anatomy -- evidence, concrete failure mode, disposition consequence, else footnote; injection-swarm lens as a triggered MUST), one triggered MUST NOT ("a reviewer would catch it" is a failed finding), and two SHOULD on a real fork (road-not-taken; steelman the strongest rejected position and name what would flip the verdict). Do NOT flatten these to one level. 4. State the trigger conditions explicitly: the injection/swarm lens fires when the target changes authority, untrusted input, prompts or envelopes, identity, concurrency, worktrees, or shared state; the reviewer-catch rule is a prohibition rather than a required recital; road-not-taken and steelman fire only when the critic actually chose among plausible mechanisms. 5. Cross-reference method-reconciliation from the critic-method heading. It stays at Stop 5 -- do not move it. 6. Point content/templates/design-critique-brief.md at the critic-method heading BY NAME. Copy no rule bodies (contract no-copy rule; the brief has its own copy of that rule). 7. Pin distinctive tokens a hollow section cannot contain: all three exact class tokens, a citations-are-claims phrase, inventory/existing-mechanisms, the injection/swarm trigger nouns, the failed-reviewer phrase, and the anatomy tokens. Extend the existing test file; do not invent a second enforcement vehicle. Do not pin whole body sentences. 8. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] line. Bound SoT: https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3661#issuecomment-5390589646.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Round-2 lean 5390589646 is bound SoT. The eight-obligation list is DECIDED, not restored -- do not re-open which items belong. The "closed restore of an accepted spec" carve-out is WITHDRAWN: the original five traced to proposed skill outline 5361349926, which current-shape 5388562160 excludes and design-critique-brief.md lists as a forbidden input, and which had seven items rather than five. Three strengths must survive: token presence is not behavioral evidence, and an empty road-not-taken or perfunctory steelman satisfies a pin while changing nothing and is paid for on every dispatch forever. Method-reconciliation stays at Stop 5 (cross-reference only). Out of scope: runtime enforcement that a critic obeyed the method -- the contract scaffolds and only the gate and content-contract tests enforce; moving method-reconciliation; copying rule bodies into the brief; restructuring the Stop 2 variant table. The Stop 2 sense of "charter" is the dominant meaning with 19 references and seven test sites -- it is not being renamed.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Ten clauses match the bound issue checklist after a two-round arc decided the list, withdrew the restore framing, and corrected a test-pin subcount. Each is independently pin-testable except the dispatch-completeness clause, which is a read-through check.
